operation.description:
Sets the default workflow permissions granted to the `GITHUB_TOKEN` when running workflows in an organization, and sets if GitHub Actions
can submit approving pull request reviews. For more information, see
"[Setting the permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN for your organization](https://docs.github.com/organizations/managing-organization-settings/disabling-or-limiting-github-actions-for-your-organization#setting-the-permissions-of-the-github_token-for-your-organization)."

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Set default workflow permissions for an organization

#/components/examples/actions-default-wo.summary: Give read-only permission, and allow approving PRs.

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/schemas/actions-can-approve.description: Whether GitHub Actions can approve pull requests. Enabling this can be a security risk.

#/components/schemas/actions-default-wor.description: The default workflow permissions granted to the GITHUB_TOKEN when running workflows.
